description: This is a configuration class for setting up a Spring Batch job related to updating account running balances in the system. It defines beans for a Step, a Job, and a Tasklet, utilizing services and repositories to configure the job's processing flow.

classes.name: AccountRunningBalanceUpdateConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up a batch job for updating account running balances.

methods.name: accountRunningBalanceUpdateStep
methods.description: Defines and builds the step for updating account running balances, involving a tasklet.

methods.name: accountRunningBalanceUpdateJob
methods.description: Creates the batch job that includes the balance update step, with an incrementer for run identification.

methods.name: accountRunningBalanceUpdateTasklet
methods.description: Instantiates the tasklet responsible for executing the balance update logic.
